name: qq-bot-monorepo
description: QQ智能机器人 - 前后端分离架构

scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.clean: python3 -c "import shutil; shutil.rmtree('backend/build', ignore_errors=True); shutil.rmtree('frontend/build', ignore_errors=True); print('✅ 清理完成')"
scripts.clean:all: python3 -c "import shutil; shutil.rmtree('backend/node_modules', ignore_errors=True); shutil.rmtree('frontend/node_modules', ignore_errors=True); shutil.rmtree('node_modules', ignore_errors=True); print('✅ 深度清理完成')"
